§ 01 · The Program

Real deals,
real decisions.

From pitching a new product and handling a price objection, to negotiating bulk discounts, contract terms, and win-win partnerships, every scenario drops you into a genuine business situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Eighty sales scenarios and twenty negotiation scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real business judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a salesperson or negotiator faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 business scenarios across pitching, objection handling, negotiation, and account management.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound business judgment under pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Sales Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping sales professionals and negotiators think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in business isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already sell, negotiate, or manage accounts in English — or are about to — Mr. Gad's Sales & Negotiation program is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the deals you'll actually face.
